card.name: The end of "syrup" after Syr
card.fires_on: The final piece "up" (or "ups") completing the word syrup after "Syr", mostly in "Oral Solution (Syrup)". It also fires on "pression" completing "suppression" after "up".

modes.label: Syrup in parentheses
modes.description: The closing piece of "Syrup" written in brackets after Oral Solution in drug labels.
modes.example: Adults 18 years of age and older : 5 mL Oral Solution (Syr<<up>>) every 4 to 6 hours

modes.label: Syrups in food text
modes.description: The ending of syrup or syrups in general text, such as simple syrup or fruit syrups.
modes.example: enjoyed as jams, candies, syr<<ups>> and even wine the whole year-round.

modes.label: Suppression split
modes.description: The ending of "suppression" when split after "up".
modes.example: up<<pression>> following the administration of irinotecan
